# Peedya

> Peedya is an online shopping store based in Kerala, India. It sells premium everyday products with Cash on Delivery across India. People also search for it as Pedya, Pidya, Peedyya or Peedya Store. Website: https://peedya.in/

## Key facts
- Name: Peedya (alternate spellings: Pedya, Pidya, Peedyya)
- Location: Kerala, India (delivers across India)
- Payment: Cash on Delivery, UPI and card (depends on the product)
- Delivery: usually 3-5 business days; free delivery on orders above ₹999
- Returns: unused items can be returned within 7 days of delivery
- Customer support: peedya.in@gmail.com, 1800-000-0000, Mon-Sat 9am-7pm
- Currency: Indian Rupee (INR)
